name: Nota Inc.
summary: Nota Inc. designs and develops an AI model development platform. The company offers NetsPresso, a platform for AI model development and optimization; Nota Vision Agent, a solution suite that provides industrial safety, surveillance, and intelligent transportation system solutions; and driver monitoring and facial recognition systems. The company has a strategic partnership with SiMa Technologies, Inc. for physical artificial intelligence technology collaboration The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Daejeon, South Korea.
